{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured black silk blouse, tailored fit, knee-length hem, #000000, smooth crepe fabric.
High-waisted charcoal wide-leg trousers, straight cut, ankle length, #36454F, heavy wool blend with slight texture.
A structured charcoal blazer, single-breasted boxy silhouette, hip length, #36454F, thick wool gabardine fabric.
Black leather loafers, classic penny detail, medium heel height, #000000, smooth calfskin leather.
Matte black stud earrings, geometric bar shape, small scale, #1C1C1C, polished brass and resin.
A delicate silver chain necklace, fine link style, choker length, #E8E8E8, sterling silver metal.

This outfit honors your request for something restrained yet classic while navigating the artificial light of a rock concert venue. The monochromatic palette of black and charcoal ensures you look polished without competing with the stage performance or blending into the crowd too early. Heavy fabrics like gabardine and wool blend provide enough structure to maintain an elegant silhouette even as you stand on your feet in a dense crowd all evening."}
